segments.thag9.1:1.1: “Yadā dukkhaṃ jarāmaraṇanti paṇḍito, aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā;
segments.thag9.1:1.3: Dukkhaṃ pariññāya satova jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
segments.thag9.1:2.3: Taṇhaṃ pahantvāna satova jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
segments.thag9.1:3.3: Paññāya passitva satova jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
segments.thag9.1:4.1: “Yadā asokaṃ virajaṃ asaṅkhataṃ, santaṃ padaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ;
segments.thag9.1:4.3: Bhāveti saññojanabandhanacchidaṃ, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
segments.thag9.1:5.1: “Yadā nabhe gajjati meghadundubhi, dhārākulā vihagapathe samantato;
segments.thag9.1:5.3: Bhikkhū ca pabbhāragatova jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
segments.thag9.1:6.3: Tīre nisinno sumanova jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
segments.thag9.1:7.1: “Yadā nisīthe rahitamhi kānane, deve gaḷantamhi nadanti dāṭhino;
segments.thag9.1:7.3: Bhikkhū ca pabbhāragatova jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
segments.thag9.1:8.3: Vītaddaro vītakhilova jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
segments.thag9.1:9.3: Sabbāsave byantikatova jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindatī”ti.
